name: PPSSPP

logFiles.label: Emulator log (log.txt, only when Developer tools > Log to file is on)

notes: PPSSPP needs no BIOS or firmware: the PSP operating system is emulated (HLE) and the required fonts ship in the assets folder.

The PPSSPP memory stick (settings, game saves, save states) lives in the OmniPC data folder, outside the program folder, so updates and rollbacks never touch it. OmniPC writes installed.txt next to PPSSPPWindows64.exe to point PPSSPP at it.
PSP game saves cannot be redirected separately from the memory stick, so they live under Emulators\ppsspp\data\memstick\PSP\SAVEDATA rather than in the Saves folder; save backups use that location.
OmniPC launches PPSSPP with --pause-menu-exit so choosing Exit in the pause menu (or the exit hotkey) closes PPSSPP and returns to OmniPC.
Controller bindings target XInput pads (Xbox-compatible controllers, or any pad exposed through Steam Input / DS4Windows). DirectInput-only pads keep PPSSPP's default mapping.
assumptions: Release assets are named PPSSPP-v<version>-Windows-x64.zip (and -Windows-ARM64.zip) per .github/workflows/build.yml 'Create release' (Compress-Archive of ppsspp/*); verified against the v1.20.4 release asset list. The zip contains PPSSPPWindows64.exe and assets/ at its root and no installed.txt.
Windows builds use the static MSVC runtime (RuntimeLibrary MultiThreaded in Windows/PPSSPP.vcxproj Release configs), so no VC++ redistributable is required.

Memory stick location on Windows: Windows/main.cpp InitMemstickDirectory(). If <exe dir>/installed.txt exists, its first line (read with fgets; a UTF-8 BOM and the trailing \n are stripped, a \r is NOT) is the memstick path; otherwise <exe dir>/memstick is used. An unusable path silently falls back to Documents\PPSSPP. OmniPC therefore writes the path with no line ending.

Config search path is <memstick>/PSP/SYSTEM (main.cpp: g_Config.SetSearchPath(GetSysDirectory(DIRECTORY_SYSTEM))); files ppsspp.ini and controls.ini (Core/Config.cpp). SAVEDATA, PPSSPP_STATE, SCREENSHOT, SYSTEM/CACHE and SYSTEM/DUMP are fixed sub-folders of <memstick>/PSP (Core/Util/PathUtil.cpp GetSysDirectory); none can be redirected via config.

Command line (v1.20.4 UI/NativeApp.cpp NativeInit and Windows/main.cpp; master Core/CmdLine.cpp g_autoParams): --fullscreen, --windowed, --pause-menu-exit, --escape-exit and a bare boot filename. Master rejects unknown --options (CommandLineParseResult::Error), so OmniPC passes only these and no '--' separator. --escape-exitsemu only works in <=1.20.x because of a strncmp prefix match, so it is not used.

[General] FirstRun (only triggers a 'Press ESC' OSD hint, UI/EmuScreen.cpp), CheckForNewVersion (version-check banner), AskForExitConfirmationAfterSeconds (default 300; >0 makes closing the window show a modal Win32 MessageBox in Windows/MainWindow.cpp ConfirmAction and the pause-menu Exit show a popup, UI/PauseScreen.cpp GetConfirmExitMessage). PauseExitsEmulator/PauseMenuExitsEmulator are CfgFlag::DONT_SAVE so they can only be set on the command line. There is no ConfirmOnQuit key.

[Graphics] GraphicsBackend uses ConfigTranslator: written as '<int> (<NAME>)', read by int or name; enum GPUBackend OPENGL=0, DIRECT3D11=2, VULKAN=3 (Core/ConfigValues.h). SoftwareRenderer (bool, forces OpenGL), InternalResolution (int, 0=auto, 1..10 x 480x272), VerticalSync (bool), FullScreen (bool). DisplayStretch lives in [DisplayLayout.Landscape] (falls back to [Graphics] for old configs). Booleans are written True/False and parsed case-insensitively (Common/Data/Text/Parsers.cpp TryParse).

controls.ini [ControlMapping]: comma-separated MultiInputMapping list, each '<deviceId>-<keyCode>' and chords joined by ':' (Core/KeyMap.cpp LoadFromIni/MultiInputMapping::FromConfigString). LoadFromIni erases the default binding of EVERY known key that is missing or empty, so OmniPC seeds PPSSPP's Windows keyboard (QWERTY) and DirectInput defaults (Core/KeyMapDefaults.cpp) when it creates the section, and otherwise only replaces the entries of its own XInput device.

XInput device ids are DEVICE_ID_XINPUT_0..3 = 20..23 (Common/Input/InputState.h). Buttons (Windows/XinputDevice.cpp xinput_ctrl_map, Common/Input/KeyCodes.h): A 96, B 97, X 99, Y 100, LB 102, RB 103, L3 106, R3 107, Start 108, Back 109, Guide NKCODE_HOME 3, D-pad 19/20/21/22. Axes are encoded 4000 + axis*2 + (negative ? 1 : 0); XInput axes LX=0, LY=1 (up is positive), RX=Z=11, RY=RZ=14 (up positive), LT=17, RT=18.

Virtual key names (Core/KeyMap.cpp psp_button_names): Up/Down/Left/Right, Circle, Cross, Square, Triangle, Start, Select, L, R, An.Up/An.Down/An.Left/An.Right, Pause, Save State, Load State, Fast-forward (hold), Screenshot, Toggle Fullscreen, Exit App (UI/EmuScreen.cpp VIRTKEY_EXIT_APP). There are no emulator volume up/down virtual keys, so those hotkeys are unsupported.
[Control] AnalogDeadzone (float, default 0.15). There is no rumble on/off setting: XInput vibration is driven only by games that use it (Windows/XinputDevice.cpp ApplyVibration).

Per-game settings: PPSSPP natively loads <DISCID>_ppsspp.ini from PSP/SYSTEM (Config::LoadGameConfig), but such a file replaces all per-game settings and controls (KeyMap::LoadFromIni restores defaults), so OmniPC applies per-game overrides to ppsspp.ini for the session only and restores just those keys afterwards. A user-created per-game config still takes precedence.
Version: Windows/ppsspp.rc FileVersion/ProductVersion = PPSSPP_WIN_VERSION_STRING (e.g. 'v1.20.4') generated by the release workflow.

PPSSPP records graphics backends that crashed during startup in <memstick>/PSP/SYSTEM/FailedGraphicsBackends.txt (UI/NativeApp.cpp); 'ALL' produces a blocking MessageBox at startup (Windows/main.cpp).
Smoke test is static only: the Windows GUI binary has no non-interactive self-test flag in v1.20.4 (--version is only handled by master's Core/CmdLine.cpp), so OmniPC never launches it to test.
